title: davallia cuneiformis
intro: Davallia cuneiformis, commonly known as the Fishbone Fern, is a type of species within the Davalliaceae family and is native to tropical regions. The health benefits of Davallia cuneiformis include its potential use in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Davallia cuneiformis contribute to its medicinal value, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential therapeutic applications.
